instruction: Create a procedural variable example in PascalABC.NET that demonstrates assigning different functions to the same procedural variable and calling them.
Create a procedure in PascalABC.NET that takes a procedural variable as a parameter to apply operations to array elements. Include examples of multiplication and printing procedures.
Create a simplified version of procedural variable usage in PascalABC.NET with lambda-style procedure definitions for array operations.
Demonstrate different ways to initialize procedural variables in PascalABC.NET including regular procedures, class methods, and static class methods with multicast delegate operations.
Create a basic procedural variable example in PascalABC.NET showing multicast delegate initialization with regular procedures, instance methods, and static methods.
Create a 3D point light visualization in PascalABC.NET using Graph3D. Include a sphere as light source, cylinder, and textured ground plane with point lighting.
Create a polynomial root finding example in PascalABC.NET using NumLibABC to find all roots of a polynomial with real coefficients.
Create polynomial operations examples in PascalABC.NET including polynomial evaluation, integration, and differentiation using NumLibABC.
Create polynomial arithmetic examples in PascalABC.NET including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and polynomial division with quotient and remainder.
Create an interactive 3D teapot in PascalABC.NET that can be moved using arrow keys for navigation in 3D space.
Create a 3D coordinate system visualization in PascalABC.NET with three colored planes (XY, XZ, YZ) and coordinate axes with labels.
Create a camera rotation animation in PascalABC.NET that orbits around a teapot object with continuous circular camera movement.
Create a prime number generator in PascalABC.NET that finds and prints large prime numbers starting from a random number.
Create a simple Print statement example in PascalABC.NET demonstrating basic output functionality.
Create a 3D group animation in PascalABC.NET where a box and sphere rotate together around a fixed point using Group object.
Create a 3D group animation with multiple objects in PascalABC.NET where an array of boxes rotates together as a group.
Create a procedure in PascalABC.NET that demonstrates all basic arithmetic operations on two integer parameters.
Create a procedure in PascalABC.NET that uses var parameters to return both division quotient and modulus results from a single operation.
Create a record type and procedure in PascalABC.NET that demonstrates parameter packing using records for drawing lines between points.
